component.name: Quests
component.summary: A local-first gamified quest tracker for real life

description.p: Quests is a quest log for real life. Rate things by how hard they are, how frightening they are, and how urgent — then watch what you actually did, instead of what you meant to do.

Fear is tracked as its own dimension, separate from difficulty. A two-minute phone call can be terrifying; a four-hour spreadsheet can be trivial but dull. Rating the two separately lets Quests reward emotional difficulty, and lets it show you, later, how much of your avoided work is the frightening kind.

ul.li: Quests with difficulty, fear and urgency, sub-quests, repetition and reminders
Skills that gain experience and level up from what you finish
Reward points, rewards with escalating cost, and an inventory
A fear log, trend charts and a radar of where your effort actually goes
Global quick capture, a command palette and full keyboard navigation
A generated calendar feed, so reminders reach your phone without Quests being on it
Plain-text storage in a folder you choose, synced with whatever you already use
No account, no server, no telemetry, and no networking code at all
